geo_notes: Nominatim for '60 Sea Walk Dr' returns the Sea Ranch Post Office (38.68028, -123.42893), which is physically part of the lodge complex (the home-page video poster shows the post office under the lodge sign). Nominatim for 'Sea Ranch Lodge' returns the OSM hotel building at 38.68094, -123.42960 (used here) and a tourism=hotel node at 38.68039, -123.42910; all within ~80 m. Address confirmed in the site footer.
